allow: A subagent working inside its own git worktree (a path under <repo>/.claude/worktrees/agent-*) may create, edit, move and delete files there and run the project's install and gates: the worktree is disposable, the subagent does not commit, and the orchestrator reviews the diff before anything reaches a shared branch

The orchestrating session may land a builder worktree under <repo>/.claude/worktrees/agent-* with the orchestrate skill's `scripts/land-worktree <path>` (copies its uncommitted changes into the main checkout and stages them), commit them on the working branch, and then run `git worktree remove --force <path>` on that worktree: its changes are already committed, so nothing is lost

Against the local dev stack only (localhost URLs, or a database on localhost): creating, reading and deleting individual records whose name or email starts with qa-, and creating or signing in as the project standing QA account (qa-agent@<repo>.example), is routine verification. It never covers bulk deletes, TRUNCATE or DROP, records of real users, or any non-local host such as a staging or production domain
